_what_this_is: Aggregate counts from the first pre-registered study in this project (personalised twin versus persistence). Counts only; no participant-level record.
_sources: docs/statistic_provenance.md section 1 (test participants surviving warm-up: 44 at K=0, 42 at K=20)
_data_source: College Experience Study (Nepal et al. 2024, doi:10.1145/3643501). See DATA_PROVENANCE.md.
_definition: K is the number of warm-up reports. n_scored is the number of test participants with reports left to score after K. n_twin_better is how many of them had a higher per-participant macro-F1 with the twin than with persistence.
